pages.h1: Aggregate Calculator for Pakistani Universities ({season_year})
pages.content:
Calculate your aggregate and, for universities that publish closing merits, see where you could get in, and open the full merit list for MDCAT, UET, NUST, COMSATS, FAST, PU and more.

Need your Matric or FSc percentage first? Use the percentage calculator. Already know your aggregate? The merit predictor checks it against {predict_count} programs. Or browse all aggregate calculators and all merit lists.

Start with MDCAT

  • MDCAT aggregate calculator: the PMDC formula (50% MDCAT, 40% FSc, 10% Matric) with last year's MBBS and BDS closing merits.
  • MDCAT merit list {season_year}: MBBS and BDS closing merit {year:uhs} for every UHS Punjab public and private college.
  • MDCAT passing marks (55% MBBS, 50% BDS, FSc 60%) and the UHS MBBS/BDS admission schedule with every official date.
  • How to calculate MDCAT aggregate and what closing merit means.

Engineering and computing

  • UET Taxila aggregate calculator (33% ECAT, 50% FSc Part-I, 17% Matric) and the UET Taxila merit list with official closing merits.
  • NUST aggregate calculator (75% NET, 15% FSc Part-1, 10% Matric).
  • COMSATS aggregate calculator (50% NTS, 40% FSc, 10% Matric).
  • UET Peshawar aggregate calculator (50% entrance test, 40% FSc Part-I, 10% Matric).
  • NED aggregate calculator (60% NED test, 40% HSC Part-I).
  • FAST aggregate calculator for computing and engineering programs.
  • GIKI aggregate calculator (85% test, 15% Matric).
  • 1st vs 2nd vs final merit list: how much merit drops between lists.

Punjab University and general universities

  • PU aggregate calculator: Punjab University's basic criteria, (Matric ÷ 4 + FSc) ÷ 1375, plus the 75/25 entry-test formula.
  • PU merit list {season_year}: closing merit {year:pu} for 257 BS programs and shifts, including PUCIT.
  • IIUI aggregate calculator (40% Matric, 60% FSc; or 15/25/60 with a test).
  • UAF aggregate calculator (30% Matric, 30% FSc Part-I, 40% entry test).
  • Air University aggregate calculator (engineering 10/50/40, other programs 15/35/50).
  • Bahria aggregate calculator (60% test, 30% FSc, 10% Matric) and ITU aggregate calculator (BS CS: 15% Matric, 35% FSc, 50% test).
  • KU merit list {season_year}: Karachi University closing percentages for test-based programmes, Pharm-D and Visual Studies.

What changed this year? Read the merit data report 2026. UET Lahore and more universities are being added next. Every number links to its official source; see how we collect them in our methodology.

faq.q: How do I calculate my aggregate?
faq.a: Pick your university above, enter your Matric, FSc and entry-test marks, and the calculator applies that university's official weights. For MDCAT the PMDC formula is 50% MDCAT, 40% FSc and 10% Matric.

faq.q: Is the aggregate the same at every university?
faq.a: No. Each university sets its own weights, so the same marks give a different aggregate at UET, NUST, COMSATS or PU. Always use the calculator for the university you are applying to.

faq.q: Where do your closing merits come from?
faq.a: Only from official merit lists and prospectuses published by the universities and UHS. Every row links to its source, and we never publish estimates as merit.

faq.q: Can I tell if I will get admission?
faq.a: The merit predictor compares your aggregate with the newest official closing merit of each program and marks each program Strong, Borderline or Unlikely. It is a guide, not a guarantee.

faq.q: Aggregate kaise nikalte hain?
faq.a: Upar apni university chunein, Matric, FSc aur test ke marks likhein. Calculator university ke official formula se aggregate nikal deta hai.

faq.q: Merit kitna jata hai?
faq.a: Har university aur program ka alag. Misaal: 2025 mein Punjab ke government MBBS colleges 93.51% se 94.87%, UET Lahore main campus Computer Science 85.83% aur PUCIT Computer Science (New Campus) 87.18% par close hue. Apni university ka page merit lists mein dekhein.

pages.h1: MDCAT Aggregate Calculator {season_year}
pages.subtitle: PMDC formula: 50% MDCAT + 40% FSc + 10% Matric
pages.answer: The MDCAT aggregate for {season_year} = 50% MDCAT + 40% FSc (pre-medical) + 10% Matric, as fixed by PMDC's admission regulations. Divide each score by its total, multiply by its weight and add: 150/180 MDCAT, 1000/1100 FSc and 1000/1100 Matric give 87.12%. Enter your marks below to get yours.

faq.q: What is the MDCAT aggregate formula for {season_year}?
faq.a: PMDC's 2026 admission regulations set the aggregate as 50% MDCAT, 40% FSc (pre-medical) or equivalent and 10% Matric or equivalent. The 2025 regulations used the same weights.

faq.q: Is the MDCAT aggregate formula the same for MBBS and BDS?
faq.a: Yes. The same 50/40/10 formula is used for MBBS and BDS; only the closing merits differ, because each college and program fills its seats separately.

faq.q: How many marks is MDCAT out of?
faq.a: MDCAT 2025 had 180 multiple-choice questions with no negative marking, according to PMDC. If your result shows a different total, change the MDCAT total in the calculator.

faq.q: What is the minimum MDCAT score for MBBS?
faq.a: In Punjab, the MBBS/BDS admission policy for session 2026-27 (notified on 14 October 2026, published by UHS) sets the MDCAT pass mark at 55% for MBBS (99/180) and 50% for BDS (90/180), and asks for at least 60% in FSc or HSSC. Below these you are not eligible for an open-merit seat, whatever your aggregate, so the calculator then lists no colleges.

faq.q: What aggregate is needed for a public MBBS college in Punjab?
faq.a: In the final 2025 UHS list, public MBBS colleges closed between 93.51% (Narowal Medical College) and 94.87% (King Edward Medical University) on open merit.

faq.q: Does Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KMU) use the same MDCAT formula?
faq.a: Yes. The KP Admission Policy 2025-26 for public MBBS and BDS colleges (run by KMU) uses MDCAT 50%, FSc 40% and Matric 10%, the same weights as this calculator.

faq.q: How much MDCAT score is needed for MBBS with 1050 in FSc and Matric?
faq.a: With 1050/1100 in both, FSc and Matric give 47.73 points. You would need about 165/180 in MDCAT to reach 93.51%, the lowest public MBBS closing merit in Punjab in 2025.

faq.q: My FSc result is out of 1200. What should I enter?
faq.a: Enter your marks and change the FSc total to 1200. The calculator converts marks to a percentage of whatever total you enter.

faq.q: Is 85% aggregate enough for MBBS in Punjab?
faq.a: Not for a public college: the lowest public MBBS closing merit in the final 2025 UHS list was 93.51%. 85% was at or above the final 2025 closing merit of 29 of the 33 private MBBS colleges, as long as you also meet the 55% MDCAT pass mark.

faq.q: Is 150 a good score in MDCAT?
faq.a: With 150/180 in MDCAT and 1000/1100 in both FSc and Matric, the aggregate is 87.12%. That is below every Punjab public MBBS closing merit of 2025 (lowest 93.51%) but at or above the final 2025 closing merit of 31 of the 33 private MBBS colleges.

faq.q: MDCAT aggregate kaise nikalein?
faq.a: MDCAT marks ko total se divide kar ke 50 se multiply karein, FSc marks ko total se divide kar ke 40 se, aur Matric marks ko total se divide kar ke 10 se. Teeno ko jama karein, yehi aap ka aggregate hai.

faq.q: Kitna aggregate ho to government medical college mil jata hai?
faq.a: 2025 mein Punjab ke government MBBS colleges ka open merit 93.51% se 94.87% ke darmiyan close hua. Har saal yeh thora upar neeche hota hai.

faq.q: MDCAT mein kitne number chahiye government college ke liye?
faq.a: FSc aur Matric dono 1000/1100 hon to 2025 ke sab se kam government MBBS merit (93.51%) tak pohanchne ke liye MDCAT mein taqreeban 173/180 chahiye; dono 1050/1100 hon to taqreeban 165/180.

pages.h1: MDCAT Merit List {season_year} & MBBS/BDS Closing Merit {year:uhs}
pages.subtitle: Punjab public and private medical and dental colleges (UHS), open merit
pages.answer: In the final 2025 UHS selection list, Punjab public MBBS colleges closed between 94.87% (King Edward Medical University) and 93.51% (Narowal Medical College) on open merit, about 0.7 to 1.2 points lower than in 2024. Private MBBS colleges closed between 90.84% and 61.00%, and public BDS colleges at about 93.4%.

faq.q: What was the MBBS closing merit in 2025 in Punjab?
faq.a: In the 13th and final UHS list for 2025, public MBBS colleges closed between 93.51% and 94.87% on open merit. King Edward Medical University was highest and Narowal Medical College lowest.

faq.q: What was the KEMU closing merit in 2025?
faq.a: King Edward Medical University, Lahore closed at 94.87% on open merit in the final 2025 list (94.92% in the 1st list), down from 96.06% in the last 2024 list.

faq.q: What is the lowest merit for private MBBS in Punjab?
faq.a: In the 5th and final 2025 UHS private MBBS list, the lowest open-merit closing aggregate was 61.00% (Queens Medical College, Kasur, for women only). Most private colleges closed well above that; check each college in the table.

faq.q: What was the BDS closing merit in 2025?
faq.a: Public BDS colleges in Punjab closed between 93.42% and 93.46% in the 13th 2025 list. Private BDS colleges closed between 73.13% and 55.87% in the 3rd list.

faq.q: Why is the 1st merit list higher than the final list?
faq.a: Students who get a seat in the 1st list move to colleges they prefer or leave, and their seats go to the next students in merit. So the last admitted aggregate usually falls with each list.

faq.q: What merit number (position) closed public MBBS in Punjab in 2025?
faq.a: In the final 2025 UHS list, the last open-merit seat at King Edward Medical University went to merit number 440 in the UHS Final Order of Merit, and at Narowal Medical College, the last public college, to 3,516. The Closing position column shows every college.

faq.q: Where is the official UHS merit list?
faq.a: UHS publishes college-wise selection lists on uhs.edu.pk. Every row in our table links to the exact official list the figure came from.

faq.q: Which government medical college in Punjab has the lowest merit?
faq.a: Narowal Medical College, at 93.51% in the 13th and final 2025 UHS list, followed by D.G. Khan Medical College (93.53%) and Sheikh Zayed Medical College, Rahim Yar Khan (93.54%). All 17 public MBBS colleges closed within 1.36 points of each other.

faq.q: Is 90% aggregate enough for MBBS?
faq.a: In Punjab, not for a public college (lowest 93.51% in the final 2025 UHS list). 90% was at or above the final 2025 closing merit of 32 of the 33 private MBBS colleges; only Al-Aleem Medical College, Lahore closed higher, at 90.84%.

faq.q: How many MBBS seats are there in Punjab government medical colleges?
faq.a: 4,151 MBBS seats in 19 public colleges for session 2026-27, of which 3,796 are open merit, according to the UHS prospectus 2026-27. This includes 100 seats each at two new colleges (Mianwali and Mandi Bahauddin) subject to PM&DC approval. BDS has 340 seats in 5 colleges.

faq.q: What is the fee of government medical colleges in Punjab?
faq.a: Rs 53,030 in the first year of MBBS (Rs 50,000 tuition plus admission fee and charges) and Rs 50,630 to Rs 50,830 a year after that, for session 2026-27. Overseas Pakistani quota seats pay US$ 10,000 a year.

faq.q: Pichhle saal MBBS ka merit kitna tha?
faq.a: 2025 mein Punjab ke government MBBS colleges ka final open merit 93.51% se 94.87% tha. KEMU sab se upar 94.87% par aur Narowal Medical College sab se neeche 93.51% par close hua.

faq.q: Merit number kitna ho to government MBBS mil jata hai?
faq.a: 2025 mein UHS ki Final Order of Merit mein KEMU ki aakhri open merit seat merit number 440 par gayi aur sab se aakhri government college (Narowal) ki 3,516 par. Har saal seats aur students badalte hain, is liye yeh sirf andaza hai.

faq.q: Private medical college ka merit kitna jata hai?
faq.a: 2025 ki final list mein private MBBS colleges 90.84% se 61.00% tak close hue. Har college ka alag merit hai, table mein apna college dekhein.

faq.q: BDS ka merit kitna jata hai?
faq.a: 2025 mein Punjab ke government BDS colleges 13th list mein 93.42% se 93.46% par, aur private BDS colleges 3rd list mein 55.87% se 73.13% par close hue.

faq.q: Government medical college ki fee kitni hai?
faq.a: Session 2026-27 mein MBBS ke pehle saal Rs 53,030 aur baad mein har saal taqreeban Rs 50,630 se Rs 50,830. Yeh fee Punjab ke tamam government medical colleges mein aik jaisi hai.

2025 ki final list mein government MBBS colleges 93.51% se 94.87% par close hue, jo 2024 se taqreeban 0.7 se 1.2 points kam hai. Apna aggregate MDCAT aggregate calculator se nikalein aur table se milayein.

faq.q: Why does private merit drop so much between lists?
faq.a: Students given a private seat early often move to a public or preferred college later, and UHS refills the seats lower down the merit. In 2025-26 private MBBS merit fell 9.07 points on average from the 1st to the final list.

pages.h1: How to Calculate MDCAT Aggregate in {season_year}
pages.answer: To calculate your MDCAT aggregate, take 50% of your MDCAT percentage, 40% of your FSc percentage and 10% of your Matric percentage, then add them. PMDC's 2026 admission regulations fix these weights. Example: MDCAT 160/180, FSc 1020/1100 and Matric 1050/1100 give 44.44 + 37.09 + 9.55 = 91.08%.

faq.q: Who decides the MDCAT aggregate formula?
faq.a: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council (PMDC) sets it in its admission regulations. Admitting universities such as UHS apply it when making merit lists.

faq.q: Has the MDCAT formula changed for {season_year}?
faq.a: No. The 2026 regulations keep the same weights as 2025: 50% MDCAT, 40% FSc and 10% Matric.

faq.q: How many aggregate points is one MDCAT mark worth?
faq.a: With MDCAT out of 180, one mark is worth about 0.28 aggregate points (50 divided by 180).

faq.q: Can I use FSc Part-I marks?
faq.a: Use marks and a total that match. If you only have Part-I marks, enter them with the Part-I total; the admitting university's notice says which marks it accepts.

faq.q: MDCAT aggregate ka formula kya hai?
faq.a: MDCAT 50%, FSc 40% aur Matric 10%. Har subject ke marks ko total se divide karein, weight se multiply karein aur jama kar lein.

faq.q: Aik MDCAT mark se aggregate kitna barhta hai?
faq.a: 180 marks ke paper mein aik mark se taqreeban 0.28 aggregate barhta hai, is liye MDCAT ke 10 marks taqreeban 2.8 points ka farq daalte hain.

pages.title: What Is Closing Merit? (Last Year Merit Explained)
pages.description: What closing merit means, why it drops from the 1st to the final merit list, and how to use last year's closing merit to judge your admission chances.
pages.h1: What Is Closing Merit and How to Use It
pages.answer: Closing merit is the aggregate of the last student admitted to a program or college in a merit list. For example, Narowal Medical College's open-merit MBBS seats closed at 93.51% in the final 2025 UHS list. Compare your aggregate with the newest official final list (older years show the trend) to judge your chances.

faq.q: Is closing merit the same as the merit list?
faq.a: No. The merit list is the list of admitted students; closing merit is one number from it, the lowest aggregate admitted for a program or college.

faq.q: Does closing merit go down in later lists?
faq.a: Usually yes, because seats left by students who move or leave are given to the next students in merit order.

faq.q: Will this year's closing merit be the same as last year?
faq.a: No. It changes with test difficulty, seats and applicants. Use the newest official final list as a guide (older years show the trend), not a guarantee.

faq.q: Is closing merit the minimum marks for admission?
faq.a: No. Minimum marks decide whether you can apply (in Punjab for 2026-27: 55% in MDCAT for MBBS and 60% in FSc). Closing merit is the aggregate of the last student admitted, which is usually far higher: 93.51% for the lowest public MBBS college in the final 2025 UHS list.

faq.q: Closing merit ka kya matlab hai?
faq.a: Kisi list mein jis aakhri student ka admission hua, us ka aggregate closing merit kehlata hai.

faq.q: Last year merit se kaise pata chale ga ke admission hoga?
faq.a: Apna aggregate har program ke sab se naye saal ki official final list, open merit closing merit se milayein (purane saal sirf trend dikhate hain). 1.5 points se zyada upar hon to chance strong hai, qareeb hon to borderline.

faq.q: Merit kitna jata hai ka matlab kya hai?
faq.a: Iska matlab hai ke pichhle saal kisi program mein aakhri admission kis aggregate par hua, yani closing merit. Misaal: Fall 2025 mein UET Lahore main campus Computer Science 85.83% par close hui.

pages.subtitle: Minimum MDCAT and FSc marks, Punjab (UHS), session {session:uhs}
pages.answer: For session 2026-27 in Punjab you need at least 55% in MDCAT (99 of 180 marks) for MBBS and 50% (90 of 180) for BDS, plus at least 60% in FSc pre-medical or equivalent (660 of 1100). These minimums are in the Punjab admission policy notified on 14 October 2026 and the UHS admission notice.

faq.q: What are the MDCAT passing marks for MBBS?
faq.a: For session 2026-27 in Punjab, 55% of the MDCAT total, which is 99 out of 180, under the Punjab MBBS/BDS admission policy notified on 14 October 2026.

faq.q: What are the MDCAT passing marks for BDS?
faq.a: 50% of the MDCAT total, which is 90 out of 180, for session 2026-27 in Punjab.

faq.q: What are the minimum FSc marks for MBBS?
faq.a: At least 60% in FSc pre-medical, HSSC or an equivalent qualification (660 out of 1100), with Biology and Chemistry passed and Physics or Mathematics as the third subject. This is regulation 5 of the PM&DC regulations 2026 and the Punjab policy for 2026-27.

faq.q: Is 52% in MDCAT enough for MBBS?
faq.a: Not for session 2026-27 in Punjab, where the MBBS pass mark is 55%. PM&DC's 8 April 2026 notification allowed 52% for MBBS and 47% for BDS only to fill vacant 2025-26 seats, with 15 April 2026 as the last date.

faq.q: Can I apply with my 2025 or 2024 MDCAT score?
faq.a: Yes. The UHS notice for session 2026-27 accepts MDCAT 2026, 2025 or 2024, as long as the score meets the 55% (MBBS) or 50% (BDS) minimum.

faq.q: If I pass MDCAT, will I get admission?
faq.a: No. Passing makes you eligible to apply; seats go by aggregate. In the final 2025 UHS lists, Punjab public MBBS colleges closed between 93.51% and 94.87% and private MBBS colleges between 90.84% and 61.00%.

faq.q: Can I get MBBS with passing marks in MDCAT?
faq.a: In a private college, possibly. With 99/180 (the 55% pass mark) and 1000/1100 in both FSc and Matric, the aggregate is 72.95%, at or above the final 2025 closing merit of 17 of the 33 private MBBS colleges in Punjab. Public colleges closed at 93.51% or higher.

faq.q: MDCAT mein kitne number par pass hota hai?
faq.a: Punjab mein session 2026-27 ke liye MBBS ke liye kam az kam 55% yani 180 mein se 99 number, aur BDS ke liye 50% yani 180 mein se 90 number chahiye.

faq.q: MBBS ke liye FSc mein kitne number chahiye?
faq.a: FSc pre-medical mein kam az kam 60% yani 1100 mein se 660 number. Biology aur Chemistry lazmi hain, teesra subject Physics ya Maths.

faq.q: How much does NET matter in the NUST aggregate?

faq.q: Is ECAT out of 400?

faq.q: Does UET Lahore use FSc Part-I or Part-II marks?

faq.q: What aggregate is needed for Computer Science at UET Lahore?

faq.q: Is the UET Lahore calculator the same as UET Taxila?

faq.q: How many ECAT marks are needed for UET Lahore Computer Science?

faq.q: Is 80% aggregate good for UET Lahore?

faq.q: UET Lahore ka aggregate kaise nikalein?

faq.q: UET Lahore mein Computer Science ka merit kitna gaya?

faq.q: How many marks is the UET Peshawar entrance test?

faq.q: What is the BS Computer Science formula at UET Peshawar?

faq.q: NED test mein pass hone ke liye kitne marks chahiye?

pages.title: 1st, 2nd and Final Merit List: How Much Does Merit Drop?
pages.description: 1st vs 2nd vs final merit list explained with real UHS 2025 figures: public MBBS dropped 0.08 points on average, private MBBS 9 points. Know which to use.
pages.h1: 1st vs 2nd vs Final Merit List
pages.answer: The 1st merit list offers seats to the top applicants; the 2nd and later lists fill seats that students leave, so the closing aggregate falls with each list. How much depends on demand: in UHS Punjab's 2025 lists, public MBBS fell only 0.08 points on average from the 1st to the final list, private MBBS about 9 points.

faq.q: How much does merit drop in the 2nd merit list?
faq.a: It depends on the program. For Punjab public MBBS in 2025 the drop from 1st to final list was under 0.15 points per college, but private MBBS colleges dropped about 9 points on average.

faq.q: Is the final merit list lower than the 1st list?
faq.a: Almost always, because each later list fills seats left by students who moved or declined, reaching further down the merit order.

faq.q: Which merit list should I compare my aggregate with?
faq.a: Last year's final list, because it shows the lowest aggregate that still got a seat. Compare with the 1st list too to see how safe you are.

faq.q: Can I get admission in the 2nd merit list if not in the 1st?
faq.a: Yes. Many students are admitted in later lists, especially in programs and private colleges where many top applicants leave.

faq.q: What is an upgrade in a merit list?
faq.a: An admitted student is moved to a higher-choice program or college when a seat opens there. UHS lists show this in an 'Upgraded To' column.

faq.q: Can merit drop a lot between lists?
faq.a: Sometimes. In 2025, private BDS at Sharif Medical & Dental College fell from 88.12% in the UHS 1st list to 73.13% in the 3rd list, while public MBBS at King Edward Medical University moved only from 94.92% to 94.87% across 13 lists.

faq.q: 2nd merit list mein merit kitna girta hai?
faq.a: Har program mein alag. 2025 mein Punjab ke government MBBS colleges ka merit 1st se final list tak sirf 0.04 se 0.13 gira, lekin private MBBS ka average 9 points.

faq.q: Pehli list mein naam na aaye to kya karein?
faq.a: Agli lists ka intezar karein aur har list ki deadline par nazar rakhein. Seat khali hone par agle students ko mauqa milta hai.

pages.roman_urdu:
Pehli merit list mein top students ko seat milti hai. Jo students chhor dete hain ya dusri jagah chale jate hain, un ki seats 2nd aur agli lists mein agle students ko milti hain, is liye merit har list ke saath neeche aata hai.

2025 mein Punjab ke government MBBS ka merit 1st se final list tak sirf 0.08 gira, lekin private MBBS ka taqreeban 9 points. Apna aggregate hamesha pichhle saal ki final list se milayein, jaise MDCAT merit list par.

pages.title: NUST & FAST Closing Merit: What They Actually Publish
pages.description: NUST publishes closing merit positions, not percentages, and FAST publishes no closing merit. How to read NUST positions and judge your chances honestly.
pages.h1: NUST and FAST Closing Merit: Positions, Not Percentages
pages.answer: NUST does not publish a closing merit percentage. It publishes closing merit positions: the rank of the last candidate admitted to each programme, which it calls a reference only. FAST-NUCES publishes no program-wise closing merit; its cut-offs are set by the university each year. Percentages for either on other websites are estimates.

faq.q: What is NUST closing merit?
faq.a: The merit position (rank) of the last candidate admitted to a programme, published on NUST's Closing Merit Positions page. NUST says it is a reference for choosing preferences, does not guarantee admission and changes every year.

faq.q: Does NUST publish closing merit in percentage?
faq.a: No. NUST ranks applicants by 75% NET + 15% HSSC Part-1 + 10% SSC and publishes closing positions, not aggregates.

faq.q: What is the FAST closing merit?
faq.a: FAST-NUCES does not publish program-wise closing merits. Its eligibility page says merit cut-off marks are determined by the university each year.

faq.q: How can I check my chances at NUST without a closing percentage?
faq.a: Calculate your aggregate with the NUST formula, then compare your merit position with the closing positions NUST publishes for each programme when results are out.

faq.q: Which universities publish closing merit in percent?
faq.a: On this site: UHS (Punjab MBBS/BDS), NUMS, UET Lahore, UET Taxila, COMSATS (Lahore, Islamabad), PU, KU and ITU (derived from its lists). They feed the merit predictor.

faq.q: NUST ki closing merit position kya hoti hai?
faq.a: Kisi program mein aakhri admit hone wale student ka NUST merit mein number (rank). Agar aap ki position us se chhoti (pehle) hai to aap us student se aage the. NUST kehta hai yeh sirf reference hai.

faq.q: FAST ka closing merit kahan milta hai?
faq.a: Kahin nahi: FAST program-wise closing merit publish nahi karta. Doosri websites par jo figures hain woh andaze hain.

pages.roman_urdu:
NUST closing merit percent mein nahi deta, balke merit position (rank) deta hai: kisi program mein aakhri admit hone wale student ka number. FAST koi closing merit publish nahi karta.

Is liye apna aggregate NUST calculator ya FAST calculator se nikalein, aur NUST mein apni position ko NUST ki closing positions se milayein.

pages.title: ECAT Aggregate Formula {season_year}: UET 33/50/17 Explained
pages.description: ECAT aggregate formula for UET Lahore and UET Taxila: 33% ECAT, 50% FSc Part-I, 17% Matric. Worked example and ECAT marks needed for each program.
pages.h1: ECAT Aggregate Formula {season_year} (UET Lahore and Taxila)
pages.subtitle: 33% ECAT + 50% FSc Part-I + 17% Matric, with ECAT marks needed per program
pages.answer: The ECAT aggregate = 33% ECAT (out of 400) + 50% FSc Part-I + 17% Matric, used by both UET Lahore (Undergraduate Prospectus Fall 2026, p. 20) and UET Taxila. Example: ECAT 280/400, FSc Part-I 480/550 and Matric 1000/1100 give 82.19%.

faq.q: What is the ECAT aggregate formula?
faq.a: 33% ECAT + 50% FSc Part-I (first year) + 17% Matric. UET Lahore sets it in its Undergraduate Prospectus Fall 2026 (p. 20) and UET Taxila uses the same weights.

faq.q: How do I calculate my ECAT aggregate?
faq.a: Divide your ECAT marks by 400 and multiply by 33, divide FSc Part-I marks by the Part-I total and multiply by 50, divide Matric marks by 1100 and multiply by 17, then add the three.

faq.q: How many ECAT marks are needed for UET Lahore Computer Science?
faq.a: With 480/550 in FSc Part-I and 1000/1100 in Matric, about 319/400 to reach 85.37%, the main-campus Computer Science closing aggregate in the Fall 2026 4th Merit List (A1 open merit).

faq.q: Does ECAT use FSc Part-I or full FSc marks?
faq.a: FSc Part-I (first year). Both UET Lahore and UET Taxila use first-year marks even if you have already finished Intermediate.

faq.q: Is the UET Peshawar formula the same as ECAT?
faq.a: No. UET Peshawar uses 50% entrance test, 40% FSc Part-I and 10% Matric, from its UG Prospectus 2026-27.

faq.q: How much is one ECAT mark worth in the aggregate?
faq.a: 0.0825 aggregate points (33 ÷ 400). Ten more ECAT marks add 0.825 points.

faq.q: ECAT ka aggregate kaise nikalte hain?
faq.a: ECAT marks ko 400 se divide kar ke 33 se, FSc Part-I ko total se divide kar ke 50 se aur Matric ko 1100 se divide kar ke 17 se multiply karein, phir teeno jama kar lein.

faq.q: UET mein Computer Science ke liye ECAT mein kitne marks chahiye?
faq.a: FSc Part-I 480/550 aur Matric 1000/1100 ke saath taqreeban 319/400. Fall 2026 mein UET Lahore main campus par Computer Science 85.37% par close hui thi.

pages.roman_urdu:
ECAT ka formula UET Lahore aur UET Taxila dono mein aik hi hai: ECAT 33%, FSc Part-I 50% aur Matric 17%.

Misaal: ECAT 280/400, FSc Part-I 480/550 aur Matric 1000/1100 ho to aggregate 82.19% banta hai. Apna aggregate UET Lahore calculator ya UET Taxila calculator se nikalein.

pages.title: PU Aggregate Calculator {season_year} (Punjab University)
pages.description: PU aggregate calculator {season_year}: Punjab University merit = (Matric ÷ 4 + FSc) ÷ 1375, or 75% academic + 25% entry test, from PU's official criteria.
pages.h1: Punjab University Aggregate Calculator {season_year}
pages.subtitle: Basic criteria: (Matric ÷ 4 + FA/FSc) ÷ (Matric total ÷ 4 + FA/FSc total)
pages.answer: The PU aggregate calculator uses Punjab University's basic criteria: merit = (Matric marks ÷ 4 + FA/FSc marks + additional marks) ÷ (Matric total ÷ 4 + FA/FSc total) × 100. With 1000/1100 Matric and 950/1100 FSc that is 1200 ÷ 1375 = 87.27%. Programs with an entry test count this academic merit 75% and the test 25%.

faq.q: What is the Punjab University merit formula?
faq.a: For BS 1st semester: (one quarter of Matric marks + FA/FSc marks + additional marks) divided by (one quarter of the Matric total + the FA/FSc total), times 100. It is printed on page 1 of PU's Merit of Last Year document.

faq.q: Does PU count Matric marks?
faq.a: Yes, but only one quarter of them. With 1100 total marks each, Matric counts about 20% and FA/FSc about 80%.

faq.q: How does the PU entry test count?
faq.a: For programs that hold a test, PU's official merit calculator gives the test 25% and the Matric ÷ 4 + FSc academic merit 75%.

faq.q: What is the PU formula for BS 5th semester?
faq.a: (Matric ÷ 4 + FA/FSc ÷ 5 + BA/BSc + additional marks) divided by the same totals. It is for students who already hold a 2-year bachelor's degree or ADP.

faq.q: How many marks does a Hafiz-e-Quran get at PU?
faq.a: 20 additional marks, added to the marks earned before dividing (PU Admission Regulations, page 23). A certificate and a departmental interview are required.

faq.q: Is this the exact merit PU will show?
faq.a: It is the basic merit. PU notes that departments make certain additions or subtractions (for example additional marks) before they display merit lists.

faq.q: PU ka aggregate kaise nikalein?
faq.a: Matric ke marks ko 4 se divide karein, FSc ke poore marks jama karein, phir (Matric total ÷ 4 + FSc total) se divide kar ke 100 se zarb dein. 1000 aur 950 marks par 87.27% banta hai.

faq.q: Punjab University mein Matric ke kitne marks count hote hain?
faq.a: Sirf aik chothai (÷ 4). Yani 1100 mein se Matric ka hissa taqreeban 20% aur FSc ka 80% hai.

faq.q: PU mein kitne aggregate par admission hota hai?
faq.a: 2025 mein Pharm-D 91.34%, PUCIT Computer Science (New Campus) 87.18% aur LLB (5 years) 81.56% par close hue, jab ke zyada tar programs 70% ya us se kam par. Apna program PU merit list mein dekhein.

pages.roman_urdu:
Punjab University ka basic formula: (Matric ÷ 4 + FSc + additional marks) ÷ (Matric total ÷ 4 + FSc total) × 100. Matric sirf aik chothai count hota hai.

Misaal: Matric 1000/1100 aur FSc 950/1100 → 1200 ÷ 1375 = 87.27%. Jin programs mein entry test hai un mein yeh 75% aur test 25% count hota hai. Pichhle saal ka merit PU merit list par dekhein.

pages.subtitle: Entrance test = pass gate (50%); merit = your Intermediate percentage
pages.answer: Karachi University does not add the entrance test to merit. For test-based programmes and Pharm-D you need at least 50% in the KU entrance test; KU then ranks you by your Intermediate percentage (+20 marks for Hafiz-e-Quran in BS). Compare that percentage with KU's closing %, e.g. BS Computer Science 80.00% in the Admissions 2027 list.

faq.q: How is merit calculated at Karachi University?
faq.a: For test-based programmes and Pharm-D, KU admits on your Intermediate (or equivalent) percentage after you pass the entrance test with at least 50% (Prospectus 2027, Appendix B). The test score itself is not added to merit.

faq.q: Does the KU entrance test score count in merit?
faq.a: No. It is a pass gate: at least 50 out of 100 for the main list. Some programmes later admitted candidates with 40, 35 or 25, each against its own academic closing percentage.

faq.q: Is 80% enough for BS Computer Science at KU?
faq.a: 80% equals the Admissions 2027 BSCS closing percentage (80.00%, test score at least 50, list of 19 October 2026), so it is exactly on the line. It was above Artificial Intelligence (79.73%) and Software Engineering (78.82%).

faq.q: Do Hafiz-e-Quran candidates get extra marks at KU?
faq.a: Yes. KU adds 20 marks for Hafiz-e-Quran candidates in BS programmes, if they do not have a third division (less than 45%) in Intermediate (Prospectus 2027, p. 21).

faq.q: What is the minimum percentage for admission in Karachi University?
faq.a: 45% in Intermediate; a 3rd division or less than 45% is not eligible. Some programmes ask for more, such as 60% Intermediate Science (Biology group) for Pharm-D and 55% for BS Computer Science and Software Engineering.

faq.q: KU ka merit kaise banta hai?
faq.a: Test-based programs mein pehle KU ke entry test mein kam az kam 50% chahiye. Uske baad merit sirf aap ki Intermediate percentage par banta hai; test ke marks merit mein jama nahi hote.

faq.q: KU mein kitne percent par admission hota hai?
faq.a: Admissions 2027 mein BSCS 80.00%, BSAI 79.73%, BSSE 78.82% aur Pharm-D morning 84.27% par close hua (test 50+). Kai open merit departments 45% ya 50% par bhi close hue.

pages.roman_urdu:

Misaal: Intermediate 900/1100 = 81.82%. Admissions 2027 mein BSCS 80.00% par close hua, is liye yeh upar hai. Poori list KU merit list par dekhein.

pages.subtitle: BS on qualification: 40% SSC + 60% HSSC · With test: 15% + 25% + 60% test
pages.answer: The IIUI aggregate for most undergraduate programs = 40% SSC (Matric) + 60% HSSC (FSc), with no admission test. Where a test is mandatory, IIUI uses 15% SSC + 25% HSSC + 60% test. Example: 1000/1100 Matric and 950/1100 FSc give 88.18%. Source: IIUI Admission Policy, sections 1.6 and 1.8.

faq.q: What is the IIUI merit formula?
faq.a: For undergraduate programs admitted on previous qualification: SSC 40% and HSSC 60%. For programs with a mandatory test: SSC 15%, HSSC 25% and test 60%, unless an accreditation body sets other weights.

faq.q: Is there an entry test for IIUI BS admission?
faq.a: Not for most programs. IIUI's policy says there is no admission test at undergraduate level except where the accreditation body requires one, such as engineering or law.

faq.q: Which FSc marks does IIUI use if my result is awaited?
faq.a: IIUI calculates merit on the marks obtained in HSSC Part-I. Enter your Part-I marks with a total of 550.

faq.q: Does IIUI round up percentages?
faq.a: No. Its policy states that 49.99% is considered 49.99%, not 50%.

faq.q: Does IIUI publish closing merit?
faq.a: IIUI displays program-wise merit lists on its website for the male and female campuses but no single closing-merit document, so we do not show closing figures.

faq.q: IIUI ka aggregate kaise nikalein?
faq.a: Matric ka 40% aur FSc ka 60% jama karein. Misaal: 1000/1100 aur 950/1100 par 88.18% banta hai.

faq.q: IIUI mein test dena zaroori hai?
faq.a: Zyada tar BS programs mein nahin. Jahan test zaroori hai wahan test 60%, FSc 25% aur Matric 15% count hota hai.

faq.q: IIUI ka merit kitna jata hai?
faq.a: IIUI har program ki merit lists website par deta hai lekin closing merit ka koi aik document nahi, is liye hum closing figures nahi dikhate.

pages.answer: The ITU aggregate for BS Computer Science and BS Artificial Intelligence = 15% Matric + 35% Intermediate (or Part-I) + 50% ITU admission test, SAT-I or USAT, per ITU's Norms & Criteria page. Example: 1000/1100 Matric, 950/1100 FSc and 60% in the test give 73.86%. You need at least 50% in the ITU test.

faq.q: What is the ITU Lahore merit formula?
faq.a: For BS CS and BS AI: Matric 15% + Intermediate 35% + admission test 50%. With O-Level only or A-Level awaited: academic record 35% + test 65%.

faq.q: What is the formula for ITU engineering programs?
faq.a: BS Electrical, Software and Computer Engineering use academic record 50% + admission test 50% (ITU test, ECAT, USAT or NTS). ITU does not state the Matric/Inter split for them.

faq.q: What score do I need in the ITU test?
faq.a: At least 50% for CS, AI, M&T and FinTech, and 40% for Economics with Data Science.

faq.q: Can I skip the ITU admission test?
faq.a: Yes, with SAT I of at least 550 in each section or a USAT-CS, USAT-E or USAT-GS score of 50% or more.

faq.q: Does ITU publish closing merit?
faq.a: ITU posts program-wise merit lists with each candidate's merit score but no closing-merit summary. Our ITU merit list page shows the lowest score in each Fall 2025 list, e.g. 81.27% for BS CS.

faq.q: ITU ka aggregate kaise nikalein?
faq.a: BS CS ke liye Matric ka 15%, FSc ka 35% aur test ka 50% jama karein. 1000, 950 aur test 60% par 73.86% banta hai.

faq.q: ITU test mein kitne marks chahiye?
faq.a: CS, AI, M&T aur FinTech ke liye kam az kam 50%, Economics with Data Science ke liye 40%.

faq.q: ITU mein CS ka merit kitna jata hai?
faq.a: Fall 2025 ki 2nd merit list mein BS Computer Science ka sab se kam merit score 81.27% tha.

pages.subtitle: Your aggregate against the newest official closing merits, {predict_count} programs
pages.answer: The merit predictor compares your aggregate with the newest official closing merit of each program (final list, open merit). More than 1.5 points above is Strong, within 1.5 points is Borderline, and lower is Unlikely. In 2025, public MBBS in Punjab closed at 93.51% to 94.87% and PUCIT Computer Science at 87.18%.

faq.q: Which university can I get with my aggregate?
faq.a: Enter your aggregate in the merit predictor and pick the university whose formula you used. It lists every program where last year's closing merit was below, near or above your aggregate.

faq.q: How accurate is the merit predictor?
faq.a: It is a guide based on the newest official closing merits. Merit can rise or fall by a point or more each year, which is why results within 1.5 points are marked Borderline.

faq.q: Can I use my MDCAT aggregate for PU or UET?
faq.a: No. Each university has its own formula. Use the MDCAT aggregate for MBBS/BDS, the PU aggregate for Punjab University and the UET Taxila aggregate for UET Taxila.

faq.q: What aggregate is needed for MBBS in a public college in Punjab?
faq.a: In the final 2025 UHS list, public MBBS colleges closed between 93.51% and 94.87% on open merit.

faq.q: Why are some universities missing from the predictor?
faq.a: We only use official program-wise closing merits. NUST, FAST, NED, GIKI, UET Peshawar, IIUI, UAF, Bahria and Air University do not publish them online, so they have calculators but no predictor rows yet.

faq.q: Is 80% aggregate good?
faq.a: It depends on the university, because each has its own formula. In the newest official lists, 80% was at or above the closing merit of 67 of 75 UET Lahore A1 rows (Fall 2025), but below every public MBBS college in Punjab (lowest 93.51% in 2025) and below PUCIT Computer Science (87.18%).

faq.q: What if my aggregate equals last year's closing merit?
faq.a: The predictor marks it Borderline, which means within 1.5 points either way. Merit moves by about a point a year (Punjab public MBBS fell 0.7 to 1.2 points from 2024 to 2025), so matching last year's figure is not enough to be sure.

faq.q: Mera aggregate 85% hai, kahan admission mil sakta hai?
faq.a: Predictor mein 85 likhein aur university chunein. Woh har program dikhata hai jis ka pichhle saal ka closing merit aap ke aggregate se kam, qareeb ya zyada tha.

faq.q: Merit predictor kaise kaam karta hai?
faq.a: Yeh har program ke sab se naye saal ka official final-list, open-merit closing merit leta hai. Aap 1.5 se zyada upar hon to Strong, 1.5 ke andar Borderline, warna Unlikely.

faq.q: Mera aggregate 80% hai, MBBS ho jaye ga?
faq.a: Punjab ke government college mein nahi: 2025 mein sab se kam 93.51% tha. Private MBBS ke 33 mein se 27 colleges 2025 ki final list mein 80% ya us se kam par close hue, bashart ke MDCAT mein 55% hon.

pages.h1: Matric and FSc Percentage Calculator
pages.subtitle: Turn your Matric, FSc Part-I or full FSc marks into a percentage
pages.answer: Your Matric or FSc percentage = marks obtained ÷ total marks × 100. For example, 1000 out of 1100 is 90.91%, and 480 out of 550 in FSc Part-I is 87.27%. Enter your marks below; universities then combine these percentages with an entry test into an aggregate.

faq.q: How do I calculate my FSc percentage?
faq.a: Divide your obtained marks by the total marks and multiply by 100. 950 out of 1100 is 86.36%.

faq.q: What is 1000 out of 1100 in percentage?
faq.a: 90.91%, because 1000 ÷ 1100 × 100 = 90.909, rounded to two decimals.

faq.q: Is the FSc percentage the same as the aggregate?
faq.a: No. The aggregate mixes Matric, FSc and an entry test with weights set by each university, such as 10/40/50 for MDCAT. Use our aggregate calculators for that.

faq.q: Do universities use FSc Part-I or full FSc marks?
faq.a: Engineering universities such as UET Taxila and NUST usually use Part-I marks, because admissions close before the Part-II result. MDCAT and Punjab University use the full FSc.

faq.q: What is 900 out of 1100 in percentage?
faq.a: 81.82%: 900 ÷ 1100 × 100 = 81.818, rounded to two decimals.

faq.q: FSc ki percentage kaise nikalte hain?
faq.a: Hasil kiye gaye marks ko total marks se divide karein aur 100 se zarb dein. Maslan 1000/1100 = 90.91%.

faq.q: Matric 1200 mein se ho to kya karein?
faq.a: Calculator mein total 1100 ki jagah 1200 likh dein. Percentage khud theek aa jaye gi.

faq.q: 1100 mein se 950 kitne percent hain?

pages.title: IBCC Equivalence Calculator: O & A Level to Marks
pages.description: IBCC equivalence calculator: turn your O level or A level grades into Pakistani marks and a percentage with IBCC's grade table (A* 90, A 85, B 75).
pages.h1: IBCC Equivalence Calculator for O and A Levels
pages.subtitle: O level and A level grades to Pakistani marks, with IBCC's official conversion table
pages.answer: IBCC converts each O or A level grade into Pakistani marks: A* above 90, A 85, B 75, C 65, D 55 and E 45 (number grades 9 to 2 run from above 90 down to 40). Your equivalence percentage is the average of your subjects, usually eight at O level and three at A level.

faq.q: How does IBCC calculate O level equivalence?
faq.a: Each grade is converted into marks out of 100 (A* above 90, A 85, B 75, C 65, D 55, E 45) and the marks of the required subjects are added. Eight subjects are needed for exams taken in Pakistan, five for exams taken abroad.

faq.q: How many marks is an A* in IBCC equivalence?
faq.a: Above 90. From the 2021 session IBCC publishes exact subject-wise A* marks for each exam session, so the value can be slightly higher than 90.

faq.q: Which subjects are compulsory for Matric equivalence?
faq.a: English, Mathematics, Urdu, Islamiyat and Pakistan Studies, plus three electives. Students abroad and foreign nationals can be exempt from Urdu, Islamiyat and Pakistan Studies.

faq.q: Is grade F or G accepted?
faq.a: No. IBCC does not accept F or G (or number grade 1) for equivalence; the minimum is E.

faq.q: O level ka IBCC equivalence kaise nikalta hai?
faq.a: Har grade ke marks lagte hain: A* 90 se upar, A 85, B 75, C 65. Saare subjects ke marks jama kar ke percentage nikalti hai.

faq.q: A level walon ka aggregate kaise banta hai?
faq.a: Pehle IBCC equivalence percentage nikalein, phir use FSc ki jagah university ke aggregate calculator mein likhein.

pages.roman_urdu:
O level ya A level ke grades chunein, calculator IBCC ke official table se marks aur percentage nikal dega. A* = 90 se upar, A = 85, B = 75.

Yeh percentage Matric ya FSc ki jagah aggregate calculator mein istemal karein. Final number IBCC certificate wala hi hota hai.

pages.answer: Apna Merit's 2026 report sums up every official closing merit we hold up to the 2026 season; the table gives the current count by university. Karachi University's test-based closing percentages rose 1.69 points on average from 2025 to 2026, while Punjab's public MBBS colleges closed 0.85 points lower in 2025 than in 2024, with KEMU highest at 94.87%.

faq.q: Did merit go up or down in 2026?
faq.a: At Karachi University, test-based closing percentages rose by 1.69 points on average from 2025 to 2026 (26 programmes). For Punjab medical colleges, the newest complete year is 2025, when public MBBS closing merits fell by 0.85 points on average from 2024.

faq.q: Which program had the highest closing merit?
faq.a: MBBS at King Edward Medical University, Lahore: 94.87% in the final 2025 UHS list (open merit). At Punjab University, Pharm-D closed highest at 91.34% in 2025; at Karachi University, Pharm-D (morning) at 84.27% in 2026.

faq.q: Why is there no 2026 data for UHS and PU yet?
faq.a: UHS had not published the 2026-27 MBBS and BDS selection lists by 31 October 2026, and Punjab University publishes its official closing summary, 'Merit of Last Year', after the season. We add both as soon as they appear.

faq.q: Can I use these figures in an article or video?
faq.a: Yes. The data is free under CC BY 4.0. Cite 'Apna Merit, Merit Data Report 2026 (apnamerit.com)' with a link; every figure also links to its official source.

faq.q: 2026 mein merit barha ya kam hua?

pages.description: What to do after the MDCAT result: calculate your aggregate, check eligibility, apply on the UHS portal, order college preferences, watch the list dates.
pages.h1: What to Do After the MDCAT Result: Step by Step to Admission
pages.subtitle: Six steps from result card to college, with the official 2026-27 rules and dates
pages.answer: After the MDCAT result, calculate your aggregate (10% Matric, 40% FSc, 50% MDCAT), check the floors (55% MDCAT for MBBS, 50% for BDS, 60% FSc), apply on the UHS portal before the deadline with all documents, order your college preferences carefully, then watch the provisional merit (13 Nov 2026), first selection list (17 Nov) and upgradation lists.

faq.q: What is the first thing to do after the MDCAT result?
faq.a: Calculate your aggregate with the 10/40/50 formula and check that you clear the floors: 55% in MDCAT for MBBS (50% for BDS) and 60% in FSc. Then apply on the UHS portal before the closing date.

faq.q: Can I use an older MDCAT score?
faq.a: Yes. The Punjab policy for 2026-27 accepts MDCAT 2026, 2025 or 2024; a score is valid for three years from the test date.

faq.q: How much is the UHS application fee?
faq.a: Rs 2,000, non-refundable, paid through Bank of Punjab or NBP by branch or 1Bill invoice. The 1Bill top-up option is not accepted.

faq.q: Do I apply separately for MBBS and BDS?
faq.a: Yes. UHS runs separate portals and separate applications for the medical and the dental programme, each with its own fee and preference list.

faq.q: What happens after the first selection list?
faq.a: Selected students pay the college fee within three working days and report to the college; vacant seats go to the next students through upgradation lists (23 Nov and 1 Dec 2026 for MBBS, with more if needed).

faq.q: MDCAT result ke baad sab se pehle kya karein?
faq.a: Apna aggregate nikalein (10% Matric, 40% FSc, 50% MDCAT), eligibility check karein (MBBS ke liye MDCAT 55%, BDS 50%, FSc 60%) aur UHS portal par deadline se pehle apply karein.

faq.q: Agar aggregate government college se kam ho to kya option hai?
faq.a: Private MBBS/BDS ki alag preference list isi UHS portal par hoti hai, NUMS ka apna process hai, aur MDCAT score teen saal valid rehta hai, is liye agle saal dobara apply ho sakta hai.

pages.roman_urdu:
MDCAT result ke baad pehle calculator se aggregate nikalein, phir dekhein ke MDCAT mein 55% (BDS 50%) aur FSc mein 60% hain. UHS portal par deadline se pehle apply karein, saari documents upload karein aur college preference ki list soch kar bharein, kyunke deadline ke baad order change nahi hota.

Phir 13 November ko provisional merit, 17 November ko pehli selection list aur us ke baad upgradation lists dekhein. Har list sirf uhs.edu.pk par aati hai.

pages.description: UHS provisional merit list (13 Nov 2026): what to check in your row, how much one wrong mark moves your aggregate, and how to report a mistake in time.
pages.h1: UHS Provisional Merit List: What to Check and How to Report a Mistake
pages.subtitle: Three days between the provisional (13 Nov) and final (16 Nov 2026) order of merit
pages.answer: The UHS provisional order of merit for 2026-27 public MBBS is due on 13 November 2026 and the final order on 16 November. Check your Matric, FSc and MDCAT marks, your aggregate (recalculate it with our calculator), your seat category and identity details, and report any discrepancy to UHS as the notice with the list directs, before the final merit is published.

faq.q: When is the UHS provisional merit list 2026?
faq.a: Friday 13 November 2026 for public MBBS and Wednesday 6 January 2027 for public BDS, according to the UHS advertisement for session 2026-27. The final order of merit follows on 16 November and 9 January.

faq.q: What should I check in the provisional merit list?
faq.a: Your Matric and FSc marks and totals, your MDCAT score, the computed aggregate, your seat category and domicile, and your name and CNIC. Recalculate the aggregate with the 10/40/50 formula to confirm it.

faq.q: How much does one MDCAT mark change the aggregate?
faq.a: About 0.28 points (one mark out of 180 at 50% weight). Ten FSc marks out of 1,100 move it by about 0.36 points and ten Matric marks by about 0.09.

faq.q: How do I report a mistake in the UHS merit list?
faq.a: Follow the notice published with the provisional list on uhs.edu.pk, which gives the method and deadline for that session, and act before the final order of merit date. The UHS advertisement lists 042-99231308-09, 042-99231078 and 042-99231071 for queries in office hours.

faq.q: Does the provisional merit list allot colleges?
faq.a: No. It only ranks eligible applicants by aggregate. College-wise allotment starts with the first selection list on 17 November 2026.

faq.q: Provisional merit list mein aggregate ghalat ho to kya karein?
faq.a: Pehle calculator se apna aggregate dobara nikalein. Phir list ke saath lagi UHS notice parhein jis mein discrepancy report karne ka tareeqa aur aakhri tareekh likhi hoti hai, aur final merit (16 November) se pehle report karein.

faq.q: Provisional aur final merit list mein kya farq hai?
faq.a: Provisional list mein sab eligible students ke marks aur aggregate rank ke saath hote hain taake ghaltiyan theek ho sakein; final order of merit wohi list theek hone ke baad hai, jis par selection lists banti hain.

pages.roman_urdu:
13 November 2026 ko UHS provisional order of merit jari karega: har student ke Matric, FSc, MDCAT marks aur aggregate rank ke saath. Apni line ghaur se dekhein: marks, aggregate, category aur CNIC. Aggregate calculator se dobara nikalein.

Ghalti ho to list ke saath lagi notice ke mutabiq UHS ko report karein, final merit (16 November) se pehle. MDCAT ka aik number aggregate ko taqreeban 0.28 points hilata hai, aur 2025 mein colleges ke darmiyan farq aksar 0.05 se 0.15 points tha.

pages.h1: Not Selected in the First Merit List: What Happens Next
pages.subtitle: Upgradation lists, how far merit fell in 2025, and your options this year
pages.answer: If your name is not in the first UHS selection list, later upgradation lists (23 November and 1 December 2026 for MBBS, more if needed) fill the seats of students who moved up or did not join. In 2025 public MBBS closing merits fell only by fractions of a point between the 1st and the 13th list, so your chance depends on how close you already are; private colleges, NUMS and next year remain open.

faq.q: In which UHS list will my aggregate get a seat?
faq.a: No one can know the 2026 lists in advance, but our tool shows, for every Punjab public MBBS college, the first of the 13 UHS selection lists of 2025 whose closing merit was at or below your aggregate. Use it as a guide: seats, applicants and the test change every year.

faq.q: When is the second UHS merit list 2026?
faq.a: The second selection/upgradation list for public MBBS is due on 23 November 2026 and the third on 1 December 2026; UHS says more lists follow until seats are filled (13 in 2025).

faq.q: How much does the closing merit drop after the first list?
faq.a: For Punjab public MBBS in 2025 the drop from the 1st to the 13th list was between 0.04 and 0.13 points per college; King Edward went from 94.92% to 94.87% and Narowal from 93.63% to 93.51%. Private colleges dropped far more.

faq.q: Is upgradation compulsory in UHS admissions?
faq.a: In public colleges yes: if a higher-preference college opens up you are moved there and must report in time or lose the admission. In private colleges a student may forgo upgradation at joining, and that choice is final.

faq.q: Can I get a college that was not in my preference list?
faq.a: No. The admission policy says a college not included in the preference list is not considered for admission or upgradation.

faq.q: What are my options if public MBBS is out of reach?
faq.a: Private MBBS/BDS through the separate UHS private preference list (Rs 600,000 deposit within three working days of selection), NUMS colleges through their own process, public BDS (portal 15 to 30 December 2026), or reapplying next year since MDCAT scores are valid for three years.

faq.q: Pehli merit list mein naam nahi aaya to kya karein?
faq.a: Agli upgradation lists (23 November, 1 December aur mazeed) dekhein. 2025 mein government MBBS ka merit pehli se aakhri list tak sirf 0.04 se 0.13 points gira, is liye agar aap kisi college ke qareeb hain to intezar karein, warna private, NUMS ya BDS ka option dekhein.

faq.q: Upgradation list mein naam aane ka kitna chance hai?
faq.a: Jitna aap ka aggregate college ke pehli list ke closing merit ke qareeb hai utna zyada. Government colleges mein merit har list mein bohat thora girta hai; private colleges mein 10 se 15 points tak gir jata hai.

pages.roman_urdu:
Pehli selection list aakhri nahi hoti. Jo students upar ke college mein upgrade hote hain ya fee jama nahi karte, un ki seats agli lists mein agle students ko milti hain. MBBS ki doosri list 23 November aur teesri 1 December 2026 ko hai; 2025 mein 13 lists aayi thin.

Lekin government colleges ka merit har list mein bohat thora girta hai (2025 mein 0.04 se 0.13 points). Apna aggregate predictor mein daal kar dekhein ke aap kis college ke kitne qareeb hain, aur saath private MBBS, NUMS aur BDS ke option bhi dekhein.

pages.title: UHS College Preference Order: How to Fill It Right
pages.description: How to order college preferences on the UHS MBBS/BDS form: the 2026-27 rules, why merit-cum-preference means order by choice, and a Reach/Match/Safe plan.
pages.h1: How to Order Your College Preferences on the UHS Form
pages.subtitle: Rules from the 2026-27 admission policy and a Reach, Match, Safe method
pages.answer: On the UHS form you must list all public colleges of your seat category in order of preference, and the order is final after the deadline. Allotment is merit-cum-preference, so list colleges in the order you would actually attend them, not by last year's merit; a high first choice never costs you a lower one. Group them Reach, Match and Safe using last year's closing merits.

faq.q: How many colleges do I have to select on the UHS form?
faq.a: For public-sector seats all colleges available for your seat category must be selected in order of preference; for private colleges there is no restriction on the number.

faq.q: Can I change my college preference order after applying?
faq.a: Only until the application deadline. After it the number and order of preferences are final and cannot be changed.

faq.q: Should I put high-merit colleges first even if my aggregate is lower?
faq.a: Yes, if you want them. Allotment is merit-cum-preference: if your rank does not reach your first choice the system goes to your next choices, so a high first choice does not cost you a lower one.

faq.q: What if I leave a college out of my list?
faq.a: It cannot be allotted to you in any selection or upgradation list. If your rank only reaches that college, you get no seat rather than a nearer one.

faq.q: Is upgradation optional?
faq.a: In public colleges it is mandatory and automatic. In private colleges you may opt out at joining, and the option once taken cannot be changed.

faq.q: UHS form mein college preference kaise bharein?
faq.a: Government seats ke liye apni category ke saare colleges order mein lagane lazmi hain. Jo college aap sach mein chahte hain woh pehle likhein, kyunke allotment merit-cum-preference par hoti hai: merit pehle dekha jata hai, phir aap ka order.

faq.q: Kya door wala college list se nikal dena behtar hai?
faq.a: Nahi. Jo college list mein nahi hoga woh kisi list ya upgradation mein nahi milega. Agar aap ka merit sirf usi college tak pohncha to seat bilkul nahi milegi, qareeb wali nahi.

pages.roman_urdu:
UHS ka form merit-cum-preference par chalta hai: pehle aap ka merit dekha jata hai, phir aap ka order. Is liye colleges ko us tarteeb se likhein jis tarteeb se aap wahan parhna chahte hain, pichhle saal ke merit ke hisaab se nahi. Pehla choice ooncha rakhne se neeche wala college nahi jata.

Deadline ke baad order change nahi hota aur government colleges mein upgradation lazmi hai. Predictor aap ke aggregate ke hisaab se Strong, Borderline aur Unlikely colleges ki tarteeb bana deta hai jise copy kar ke apni pasand se adjust karein.
